prompt: My StackOne API call is returning 401 Unauthorized. I am sending my API key in the Authorization header. What is wrong and where is the current authentication documentation?
skill_note: A 401 from the StackOne API is a platform question, so the skill should fire.

fetch.name: fetches-current-auth-page
fetch.note: The skill sends the agent to the current authentication page.

no_fetch.name: avoids-dead-auth-page
no_fetch.note: The agent never fetches the retired `/overview/authentication` page, which returns 404.
